question_text: Which of the following is absolutely necessary for the production of sound? / ध्वनि (Sound) उत्पन्न करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से क्या अत्यंत आवश्यक है?
explanation: Sound is a form of energy that is produced only when an object vibrates. / ध्वनि (Sound) ऊर्जा का एक रूप है जो केवल तभी उत्पन्न होती है जब कोई वस्तु कंपन (Vibrate) करती है।
distractor_rationale: Options A and B are forms of energy but unrelated to creating sound. Option D (vacuum) actually prevents sound from travelling.

ai_context.learning_goal: Understand that vibration is the fundamental cause of sound.
common_misconceptions: Students might think sound is a material substance or doesn't require physical movement.
ai_context.hint: Think about what happens to your throat when you speak.

question_text: If an explosion occurs on the Moon, why will it not be heard on Earth? / यदि चंद्रमा पर कोई विस्फोट होता है, तो वह पृथ्वी पर क्यों नहीं सुनाई देगा?

options.A: The sound frequency is too high. / ध्वनि की आवृत्ति (Frequency) बहुत अधिक है।
options.B: The Moon is too small. / चंद्रमा बहुत छोटा है।
options.C: Sound cannot travel through the vacuum of space. / ध्वनि अंतरिक्ष के निर्वात (Vacuum) से होकर नहीं गुजर सकती।
options.D: The Earth's atmosphere reflects the sound. / पृथ्वी का वायुमंडल ध्वनि को परावर्तित करता है।

explanation: Sound requires a material medium (solid, liquid, or gas) to travel. Space is mostly a vacuum, so sound waves cannot pass from the Moon to the Earth. / ध्वनि को यात्रा करने के लिए एक भौतिक माध्यम (Medium) की आवश्यकता होती है। अंतरिक्ष एक निर्वात (Vacuum) है, इसलिए ध्वनि तरंगें चंद्रमा से पृथ्वी तक नहीं आ सकती हैं।
distractor_rationale: A is incorrect as frequency does not prevent propagation. B is irrelevant. D is incorrect because the sound never reaches the atmosphere to begin with.

ai_context.learning_goal: Grasp that sound requires a physical medium to propagate.
common_misconceptions: Many students believe sound can travel in space like light does.
ai_context.hint: Remember that sound is like a relay race of particles. Are there particles in space to pass the baton?

question_text: The loudness of sound depends on its: / ध्वनि की प्रबलता (Loudness) किस पर निर्भर करती है?
explanation: The loudness of sound is directly proportional to the square of the amplitude of vibration. Larger amplitude means a louder sound. / ध्वनि की प्रबलता (Loudness) कंपन के आयाम (Amplitude) पर निर्भर करती है। अधिक आयाम का अर्थ है अधिक प्रबल ध्वनि।
distractor_rationale: Frequency determines pitch, not loudness. Time period is the inverse of frequency. Speed depends on the medium.

ai_context.learning_goal: Correlate amplitude with the loudness of sound.
common_misconceptions: Students often confuse pitch (frequency) with loudness (amplitude).
ai_context.hint: Think about hitting a drum very hard. The skin moves further up and down (larger displacement) and makes a louder sound.

question_text: A baby's voice is shriller than a man's voice because the baby's voice has a: / एक बच्चे की आवाज़ आदमी की आवाज़ से अधिक तीखी (shrill) होती है क्योंकि बच्चे की आवाज़ में होती है:
explanation: Shrillness or pitch is determined by the frequency of vibration. A higher frequency results in a higher pitch, which is why a baby's or woman's voice sounds shriller. / तीखापन या तारत्व (Pitch) कंपन की आवृत्ति (Frequency) से निर्धारित होता है। उच्च आवृत्ति के कारण तारत्व उच्च होता है, यही कारण है कि बच्चे की आवाज़ अधिक तीखी होती है।
distractor_rationale: Lower frequency makes a deeper bass voice. Amplitude controls how loud the voice is, not how shrill it is.

ai_context.learning_goal: Apply the concept of frequency to pitch and real-world sounds like human voices.
common_misconceptions: Assuming that a shrill voice is just a louder voice.
ai_context.hint: Shrillness relates to pitch. Which physical property (frequency or amplitude) controls pitch?

question_text: What is the audible range of frequencies for a normal human ear? / सामान्य मानव कान के लिए श्रव्य आवृत्तियों (Audible frequencies) की सीमा क्या है?
explanation: The human ear can only hear sounds with frequencies between 20 Hz and 20,000 Hz. Sounds below 20 Hz are infrasonic, and above 20,000 Hz are ultrasonic. / मानव कान केवल 20 हर्ट्ज (Hz) से 20,000 हर्ट्ज के बीच की आवृत्ति वाली ध्वनियों को ही सुन सकता है।
distractor_rationale: Other ranges are factually incorrect for humans. Dogs and bats can hear ultrasonic frequencies above 20,000 Hz.

ai_context.learning_goal: Memorize the standard human audible frequency range.
common_misconceptions: Assuming humans can hear all possible sounds.
ai_context.hint: It starts from 20 and goes up to twenty thousand.
